global.description: The construction is a supersymmetric type-I seesaw in which the finite modular field couples to right-handed neutrinos through their Majorana mass term.

source_chunks_or_sections.quote_or_summary: The paper states that residual finite modular symmetry mimics U(1)_{B-L} and yields a pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone majoron.
The model uses a supersymmetric type-I seesaw with modular-form Majorana masses for right-handed neutrinos.
The majoron coherent oscillation can be dark matter, while modulus decay can yield majorons contributing to dark matter or dark radiation.
